project: Cross-Domain Complaint Understanding via Multilingual Encoders

classes.definition: Disputes asserting that inaccurate, outdated, or erroneous data appears on credit reports.
Complaints concerning the procedural failure, delay, or inadequacy of a credit reporting agency's investigation into a previously filed dispute.
Unauthorized inquiry, impermissible access, identity theft credit monitoring, or inability to access credit reports.
rule_patterns: unable to get your credit report

classes.definition: Unauthorized financial transactions, identity theft, scams, or unaddressed fraud alerts.
rule_patterns: problem with fraud alerts or security freezes

classes.definition: Collection attempts for debts that the consumer does not owe, was already paid, or was discharged.
rule_patterns: attempts to collect debt not owed
cont'd attempts collect debt not owed

classes.definition: Unlawful harassment, abusive language, illegal legal threats, or misrepresentation by debt collectors.
rule_patterns: took or threatened to take negative or legal action

classes.definition: Violations related to frequency, timing, or required disclosures in debt collection communications.
Failures in processing, crediting, or executing incoming debt/bill payments or unauthorized recurring debits.
rule_patterns: problem with a lender or other company charging your account

classes.definition: Disputes regarding merchant charges, card usage failures, unauthorized point-of-sale items, or point-of-sale transfer issues.
rule_patterns: problem with a purchase shown on your statement
problem with a purchase or transfer

classes.definition: Delays, holds, unexpected unavailability of deposited funds, overdraft penalties from delayed availability.
rule_patterns: problem caused by your funds being low
managing, opening, or closing your mobile wallet
money was not available when promised
money was taken from your bank account on the wrong day

classes.definition: Inability to log in, locked online portal, branch access denial, or forced closure/freezing of account.
Administrative friction in managing, opening, modifying account terms, or updating profile details.
Escrow calculation errors, customer service failures, payoff quote delays, or repossession disputes during loan lifecycle.
rule_patterns: dealing with your lender or servicer
dealing with my lender or servicer
problems at the end of the loan or lease
problem with the payoff process at the end of the loan

classes.definition: Friction, misrepresentation, delay, or unexplained rejection during the loan, mortgage, or credit card origination/application process.
rule_patterns: taking out the loan or lease
was approved for a loan, but didn't receive the money

classes.definition: Disputes regarding unexpected fees, APR interest rate increases, credit line cuts, misleading advertising, or reward point denial.
rule_patterns: charged fees or interest you didn't expect
problem with additional add-on products or services

classes.definition: Disputes occurring at mortgage settlement, closing disclosure discrepancies, or unexpected closing fees.
